w.brief: See champion wiki for full W details.

e.name: Reckless Swing
e.brief: See champion wiki for full E details.
e.full: Olaf dashes to an enemy and attacks with such force that it deals true damage to his target. If the target does not die, Olaf takes true damage.

champions.name: Ornn
champions.title: The Fire Below the Mountain

passive.name: LIVING FORGE
passive.brief: Living Forge: upgrade ally items at level 14
passive.full: Ornn gains additional bonus Armor and Magic Resistance from all sources. Ornn can spend gold to forge non-consumable items anywhere. Additionally, when Ornn reaches a certain level, forging items will grant a nearby ally the ability to buy one item from anywhere on the map. This will trigger every few levels.

q.name: VOLCANIC RUPTURE
q.brief: See champion wiki for full Q details.
q.full: Ornn slams the ground, sending out a fissure dealing damage and slowing enemies hit. After a small delay, a magma pillar forms at the end location.

w.name: BELLOWS BREATH
w.brief: See champion wiki for full W details.
w.full: Ornn advances, breathing fire. Enemies hit by the final gout of flame become Brittle.

e.name: SEARING CHARGE
e.brief: See champion wiki for full E details.
e.full: Ornn charges, dealing damage to enemies he passes through. If Ornn collides with terrain while charging, the impact creates a shockwave around him which deals damage and knocks up enemies.

r.name: CALL OF THE FORGE GOD
r.brief: Call of the Forge God: summon ram → redirect for AoE knockup
r.full: Ornn summons a massive elemental at a location which travels toward him with increasing speed. Enemies run over by the elemental take damage, are slowed and are made Brittle. Ornn can recast the ability to charge into the elemental, redirecting it in the direction he hits it, causing the elemental to affect any enemies it runs over to be knocked up, dealing the same damage and re-applying Brittle.

passive.full: Periodically, Yuumi’s Basic Attacks and Abilities will Shield Yuumi. If Yuumi is Attached to an ally or attaches within a few seconds they are Shielded for the same amount. While Attached to an ally, Yuumi grants them Friendship stacks when they kill enemy champions or minions. The ally with the highest Friendship stack becomes Yuumi’s Best Friend, which empowers her abilities towards them.

q.name: PROWLING PROJECTILE
q.brief: See champion wiki for full Q details.
q.full: Yuumi fires a missile, dealing Magic Damage to the first target hit. It deals bonus damage and Slows if it takes at least 1 second to get to its target. While Attached, the missile can be controlled with your cursor. Best Friend Bonus: Applies Slow on hit, and when hitting an enemy champion, Yuumi’s Attached ally gains bonus Magic Damage toward them.

w.name: YOU AND ME!
w.brief: See champion wiki for full W details.
w.full: Passive: While Yuumi is Attached to her Best Friend, She gains bonus Healing and Shielding, and her Best Friend also receives additional Healing effects. Active: Yuumi dashes to a target ally, becoming untargetable from everything except turrets.

e.name: ZOOMIES
e.brief: See champion wiki for full E details.
e.full: Yuumi grants herself a Shield and gains Attack Speed. She also gains Move Speed while the Shield is active. If Yuumi is Attached, Zoomies affect her ally.

r.name: FINAL CHAPTER
r.brief: Final Chapter: 3 waves of damage + root on 3rd hit. Cast while attached.
r.full: Yuumi launches five waves in the target direction. While Attached Yuumi can steer the direction of the waves. Detaching stops this bonus effect. Allied champions hit by the waves are Healed, with increased Healing for the Best Friend. Excess Healing converts into a Shield. Enemies struck by the waves take Magic Damage and are Slowed. The Slow stacks and refreshes on each hit.

passive.name: Contempt for the Weak
passive.brief: Contempt for the Weak: bonus damage to low-HP targets
passive.full: Zed's basic attacks against low health targets deals bonus Magic Damage. This effect can only occur once every few seconds on the same target.

q.name: Razor Shuriken
q.brief: See champion wiki for full Q details.
q.full: Zed and his shadows throw their shurikens. Each shuriken deals damage to every enemy hit.

w.name: Living Shadow
w.brief: See champion wiki for full W details.
w.full: Passive: Zed gains energy whenever he and his shadows strike an enemy with the same ability. Energy can only be gained once per cast ability. Active: Zed's shadow dashes forward, remaining in place for a few seconds. Reactivating Living Shadow will cause Zed to switch positions with this shadow.

e.name: Shadow Slash
e.brief: See champion wiki for full E details.
e.full: Zed and his shadows slash, dealing damage to nearby enemies.

r.name: Death Mark
r.brief: Death Mark: dash to target → mark → swap back. Mark pops for % of damage dealt.
r.full: Zed becomes untargetable and dashes to an enemy champion, marking them. After a few seconds the mark triggers, repeating a portion of all the damage Zed dealt to the target while they were marked. Zed leaves a shadow behind and can reactive Death Mark to switch places with this shadow.

champions.title: The Hexplosives Expert

passive.name: Short Fuse
passive.brief: Short Fuse: periodically empowered AA deals bonus damage
passive.full: All of Ziggs’s abilities also damage structures. Periodically, his next ability deals bonus magic damage. This cooldown is reduced whenever Ziggs uses an ability.

q.name: Bouncing Bomb
q.brief: See champion wiki for full Q details.
q.full: Ziggs throws a bouncing bomb that deals magic damage.

w.name: Satchel Charge
w.brief: See champion wiki for full W details.
w.full: Ziggs flings an explosive charge that detonates after 4 seconds, or when this ability is activated again. The explosion deals magic damage to enemies, knocking them away. Ziggs is also knocked away, but takes no damage. Ziggs can use the Satchel to hexplode vulnerable enemy turrets.

e.name: Hexplosive Minefield
e.brief: See champion wiki for full E details.
e.full: Ziggs scatters proximity mines that detonate on enemy contact, dealing magic damage and slowing. Successive mine detonations on the same target deal reduced damage.

r.name: Mega Inferno Bomb
r.brief: Mega Inferno Bomb: long-range massive AoE bomb
r.full: Ziggs deploys his ultimate creation, the Mega Inferno Bomb, hurling it an enormous distance. Enemies in the primary blast zone take more damage than those farther away. When quick casting, the bomb will target the enemy with the lowest HP.

champions.name: Zilean
champions.title: The Chronokeeper

passive.name: TIME IN A BOTTLE
passive.brief: Time in a Bottle: store XP, grant to ally for level advantage
passive.full: Zilean stores time as Experience and can grant it to his allies. Zilean can impart this Experience on the nearest allied champion when he has enough to complete their next level up. Zilean receives as much Experience as he gives.

q.name: TIME BOMB
q.brief: See champion wiki for full Q details.
q.full: Tosses a bomb to target area that sticks to units that come near it, prioritizing champions and units already carrying a bomb. When it detonates it deals magic damage to the target and nearby enemies. If a Time Bomb is detonated early by another Time Bomb, it also stuns enemies. The Time Bomb can be recharged 2 times.

w.name: TWISTED TIMEFLOW
w.brief: See champion wiki for full W details.
w.full: Makes time flow faster for himself, applying Fleeting Time to himself and gaining a damage absorbing shield. Zilean also grants Fleeting Time and identical shield to his nearest ally champion. Fleeting Time increases projectile speeds and grants move speed. Fleeting Time also increases Zilean’s ability haste.

e.name: TEMPORAL MIRAGE
e.brief: See champion wiki for full E details.
e.full: Creates a time-bending force field at target location. Within the force field enemy champions and projectiles are slowed.

r.name: CHRONOSHIFT
r.brief: Chronoshift: mark ally → if they die within 5s, revive with HP
r.full: Places a protective time rune on Zilean or an allied champion. If the rune bearer takes lethal damage during this time, they teleport back in time and become untargetable before they are revived and healed. If the rune bearer does not trigger the rune's revival effect, a part of Chronoshift's cooldown will be refunded.

champions.name: Zyra
champions.title: Rise of the Thorns

passive.name: GARDEN OF THORNS
passive.brief: Garden of Thorns: seeds spawn near Zyra. Abilities on seeds = plants.
passive.full: When hitting enemies with Grasping Roots, Zyra spawns Thorn Spitters who fight for her. If it misses, a Thorn Spitter will spawn at the end of the root’s travel path instead. Thorn Spitters automatically attack Zyra’s target, dealing Magic Damage. Deadly Spines or Stranglethorns spawn additional Thorn Spitters for each extra enemy champion, large monster, or epic monster hit.

q.name: DEADLY SPINES
q.brief: See champion wiki for full Q details.
q.full: Thick vines spread through the ground and explode into spines, dealing magic damage to enemies within the area. Zyra will also spawn a Thorn Spitter, dealing damage. For each enemy hit the number of Thorn Spitters will increase.

w.name: RAMPANT GROWTH
w.brief: See champion wiki for full W details.
w.full: Zyra enrages all Thorn Spitters near her. Enraged Thorn Spitters’ duration get reset and they gain bonus Health and bonus Attack Damage.

e.name: GRASPING ROOTS
e.brief: See champion wiki for full E details.
e.full: Zyra sends forth vines through the ground to ensnare her target, dealing Magic Damage and rooting enemies they come across. Zyra spawns a Thorn Spitter when the vines hit the first enemy, or after the skill is cast if no enemy is hit.

r.name: STRANGLETHORNS
r.brief: Stranglethorns: AoE knockup + empowers all plants in zone
r.full: Zyra summons a massive thicket at a target location, dealing Magic Damage to enemies as it expands and knocking them airborne as it contracts. When enemy champions are hit, a Thorn Spitter will spawn.
